(oṃ)༄༅/ /edhi/nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /༈/oṃ swasti/bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnya

tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// edhi/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swasti/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib gnyis gtan spangs nas// rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i// rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// mi 'gyur bde ba mchog brnyes rnal 'byor ma// grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa// lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung ḍe gi pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// don dam mchog brnyes grub chen andharba// rnam dag ting 'dzin mthar son tai lo pa// gsang chen bstan pa rgyas mdzad nā ro pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag= /lam bzang gsal mdzad pham thing sku mched gnyis// zab mo'i lam gyi rgyun sbyangs shes rab brtsegs// 'jig rten mig 'byed rje btsun blo gros grags// gsol ba= /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa// rlabs chen shes bya'i gnas rig bsod nams rtse// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje btsun rin po che// gsol ba= /kun mkhyen gnyis pa sa skya paṇḍi ta// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab 'phags pa rin po che// 'jig rten chos brgyad spangs pa'i dkon mchog dpal// gsol ba= /brtson pas grub pa lhur len brag phug pa// 'gro kun brtse bas rjes 'dzin blo gros brtan// de sras thu bo dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// gsol ba= /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gsal mdzad chos kyi rje// bde gshegs bstan pa'i khur 'dzin rin po che// dmigs med thugs rje'i dbang phyug ye shes zhabs// gsol ba= /rnam mang sngon 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyud sbyangs shing*// yang dag dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur te// gsang chen byin rlabs rim pas smin byas nas// rim gnyis lam la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// tha mal snod dang bcud du rab zhen pa'i// kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i snang ba ma lus pa// rnam dag lha yi sku ru bsgyur byed pa'i// mkha' spyod bskyed rim bsgom par byin gyis rlobs// gzung 'dzin spros pa skye med ro rkyang rlung*// g.yas g.yon 'pho ba med par bgag byas nas// dbu mar zhugs nas spros med mchog skye ba'i// rdzogs rim dbu mar bsgom par byin gyis rlobs// ting 'dzin lam gyi bar chad kun spangs shing*// mtha' yas rtogs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs nas// sku gsum dbyer med mkha' spyod chen po yi// go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/

/yang na chos rje ba'i rjes la/ /dam pas byin rlabs tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal// mtha' yas man ngag kun mkhyen nyan chen pa/ zhes dang*/ blo gros brtan pa'i tshab tu/ /'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ zhes bcug la bya'o// mkha' spyod man ngag gi bla ma brgyud rim la gsol ba 'debs pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o/// /edhi/ ༈ /rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen nā ro pa dang pham thing pa// shes rab brtsegs dang mal gyo sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bskyed rim zab mo mkha' spyod rnal 'byor dang*// rdzogs rim dbu ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mthus// bde chen lhan skyes ye shes skye ba dang*// mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces pa dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// /rdo rje 'chang chen kun dga' bzang po dang*// sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs// bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal// kun spangs chos rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes kha skongs so// kun dga' legs pa tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse mkhan chen bslab gsum zhabs// rtsa ba'i bla ma drin can 'khor lo'i mgon// dbang phyug rab brtan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rtsa ba'i bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ༈ /dhi/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mchog gi padmo bzhad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hī/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos// rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rgyal sras thu bo nā ro ta pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin pa'i pham thing pa// gsang mdzod kun gyi gter gyur shes rab brtsegs// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mal lo'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so=

/rdo rje 'chang dbang bla chen sa skya pa// rdo rje'i sras mchog rje btsun bsod nams rtse// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan grags pa'i zhabs// gsol ba= /sa skya paṇa chen gangs can mkhas pa'i rje// sa gsum skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan 'phags pa'i mchog /sa skya'i bstan 'dzin zhang ston chos rje'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// grub pa'i dbang po na bza' brag phug pa// grub mchog mkhas pa'i ded dpon chos kyi rje// grub rigs snyan brgyud mnga' bdag yar klung pa// gsol ba= /bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba mchog /bdag nyid chen po 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan// bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal// gsol ba= /bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun rdo ring pa// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin blo gsal dbang*// bka' brgyud gsang chen smra ba mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// gsol ba= / kha skong ni rmor chen nas/ rig sngags 'chang ba sangs rgyas rin chen dang*// rigs kun khyab bdag mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// rigs kyi bdag pos rjes bzung ngag gi dbang*// gsol ba= /rab 'byams mdo sngags kun la mkhyen rab rgyas// dga' chen khyab bdag he ru ka yi dngos// 'phrin las lhun grub drin chen bla ma la// gsol ba= / kha skong mkhyen brtse nas bcug na legs snyam/ dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi// ba dan dkar pos skyod pa'i las 'bras kyis// blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas// 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /bslu med skyabs gnas gtsug gi nor bur bsten// ma gyur 'gro ba'i don chen snying la zhugs// rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes pa'i dri bkrus nas// rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rjes skyong bar shog /yid 'ong rgyal yum phyi yi rnal 'byor ma// bam̐ yig nang gi rdo rje gtso mo'i mchog /sems nyid stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum// rang zhal mthong ba'i brtse dgas rol par shog

/snod kyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal yas khang*// bcud kyi sems can bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// cir snang dag pa'i snang ba 'char bar shog /de ltar phyogs dang zla ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// nam zhig dus na dga' ma byi ru'i mdog /li khri'i skra grol dmar ser mig g.yo bas// mngon sum rig 'dzin grong du 'khrid par shog /sindhur laṅka li yi sdong por bcas// ro ldan gnas su bsgrubs shing yul kun du// nyul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can// 'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin 'khril shing bcom// mchog gi dhū tir zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma// tshangs pa'i sgo nas sprin lam dbyings su thim// khrag 'thung dpa' bor 'khyud cing rol par shog /lte ba'i padmor rlung lnga'i ti la ka /rtse gcig bsgom pa'i kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyi// lus sems rtsa la dri bzhon zhugs pa yis// bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par shog /tha mal 'od kyi gtum mo mdzes ldan ma// dhū ti'i 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i rol rtsed kyis// haṃ yig gzhon nu yongs su myos byas nas// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sa thob shog /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba'i gdod ma'i gshis// stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang*// zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rnal 'byor ma// rang ngo shes nas rtag tu skyong bar shog /rtsa rlung thig le e waṃ dbyings su thim// sems nyid bde chen chos sku'i dpal thob nas// bgrang yas gzugs sku'i rnal rol grangs med kyis// nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro 'di skyong bar shog / ces 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu jo bo nā ro ta pas mngon sum du rjes su bzung ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod du grags pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa lam gyi rim pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa mchog gi padmo bzhad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni/

rje btsun ma'i zhabs kyis ring nas skyongs ba'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis stod lung spa ra'i gzim khang gi yang thog me mtshams kyi ba gam bzhi par rakta bzhad pa'i phyogs kyi tshes la sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ maṅga laṃ// ༈ /edhi/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bstod pa ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na maḥshrī badzra yo gi nī ye/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dad pa'i yid kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi// 'dab brgya'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// padma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma// mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// chags can skyes bu 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir// bstan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dpal dang*// gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyi rol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che// 'gyur med dga' ba gya nom bla na med// rgyun mi chad pa'i bde ba'i ros gang ma// mkha' spyod bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzes pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma// mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang*// thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus la// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ma// mkha' spyod snying rje'i yongs gang la phyag 'tshal// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas// rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// mkha' spyod rgyun chad med la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rjes gzhan gyi dbang gyur nas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par rab bzhugs ma// mkha' spyod 'gog pa med la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab nas// sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// mkha' spyod sku yi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// dus gsum ngag dang yid kyi rab bzlas pas// srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spangs brjod bral gsung*// mkha' spyod gsung gi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam// sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas legs bsgoms pas// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas// tshe 'di nyid dam bar do la sogs par// mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog

/ mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rnal 'byor ma dpal la// bstod pa'i tshig 'di bshes gnyen dam pa 'gas// yang yang bskul nas dge slong rgyud gsum pas// mkhas pa'i chos grwa dpal ldan sa skyar bris// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
